name: M3_MMS200MI_CpyItmWhs
description: Copy an existing item-warehouse setup to create a new connection between an item and a warehouse. The operation adds an item to a specific warehouse by using another item that is already connected to a (possibly different) warehouse as the template. Warehouse-specific master data such as storage, allocation, planning, costing, and logistics controls are taken from the source item/warehouse combination, so you avoid re‑entering many parameters when the same setup is required for another item or warehouse.
